findings.finding: All 48 main attention output weights are MXFP8. Attention/KV heads, linear-attention heads, expert count and intermediate dimensions are divisible by two. MTP output projection remains BF16.
Checkpoint tensors total 102138950916 bytes: routed experts 65.78 GB, PLE table 28.80 GB; other components 7.56 GB. Altering attention output precision again is not the first performance opportunity.

Baseline allocates 53.18 GiB KV per rank for 5.42M tokens (20.69 full-context equivalents), yet caps active sequences at eight. Reserving 13.41 GiB per-rank for shared PLE can remove disk transactions while retaining eight full-context equivalents.
C16 request fanout exceeds max_num_seqs=8. Baseline p95 TTFT across repeated code/prose fixtures is 12.508 seconds; C8 aggregate throughput is higher than C16.

13/13 core checks, 3/3 invoice OCR and 261623-token retrieval pass. Three executed code fixtures pass with corrected duration prompt; sliding-window fixture uses an import despite the prompt constraint. Initial duration fixture was inconsistent and is unscored.
